description: Pushes a week of strength guides: one NEW SuuntoPlus guide per date, built and sent like push_strength_guide (same arguments per guide, without guideId). dryRun defaults to TRUE: it only validates every guide and returns what it would push, without contacting Suunto; show that to the user and call again with dryRun: false only when they agree. With dryRun false everything is validated first, then the guides are pushed in date order (queued, each read back from the guide list); the first failure stops the push and the result lists failed and notPushed (say which days are missing). Pushing the same plan twice creates duplicates (list_guides / delete_guide tidy up; push_strength_guide with guideId overwrites one). At most 14 guides. Needs SUUNTO_APP_NAME for a real push; guides appear after the phone's next Suunto app sync. Write operation (dryRun false).

dryRun.description: true (default): validate only. false: push the guides.

guides.description: One strength guide spec per date (dates must differ).

detail.description: Display string for set steps (and prep unless 'plates' is given), with weight and sets, e.g. '60kg 3x10'.

last.description: Optional: last time, e.g. '3x8@60kg' (get_exercise_history suggestion.last). Shown with target in a 'TODAY' popup at prep (36 characters max: shortened, then dropped). Unverified on a real watch.

plates.description: Per-side plates for barbell lifts, e.g. '2x20+1x5/side', shown on prep. Compute it yourself.

restSec.description: Rest between sets in seconds (countdown length; only a label in 'stopwatch' mode).

restTargetHr.description: Optional HR (bpm, 41-200) to recover to: a gauge on this exercise's rests, visual only.

lapGranularity.description: 'perSet' (default; a lap per set and rest) or 'perExercise'.

title.description: Session name shown in the Suunto app.

name: push_week_plan
title: Push a week of strength guides to the watch (dry run by default)
